007package com.oracle.database.selectai.samples.agent;
008
009import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.agent.RunTeamParams;
010import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.agent.RunTeamRequest;
011
012import java.math.BigDecimal;
013import java.util.List;
014import java.util.Map;
015
016/**
017 * Builds precise runtime variables and reuses a team-run request builder.
018 * No database connection or environment variables are required. This sample
019 * only serializes requests; use RunTeamSample to submit a request with a real
020 * conversation identifier.
021 *
022 * @see RunTeamSample
023 * @see AgentWorkflowSample
024 */
025public final class RunTeamParamsSample {
026    private RunTeamParamsSample() {
027    }
028
029    /**
030     * Prints typed parameters and independent requests built from one builder.
031     *
032     * @param args command-line arguments; not used
033     */
034    public static void main(String[] args) {
035        BigDecimal amount = new BigDecimal("1.234567890123456789");
036        Map<String, Object> values = Map.of("amount", amount,
037                "items", List.of(Map.of("amount", amount)));
038        RunTeamParams params = RunTeamParams.builder()
039                .instructionVariables(values)
040                .attributeVariables(values)
041                .stateVariables(values)
042                .build();
043        System.out.println("Precise runtime parameters: " + params.toParamsJson());
044
045        RunTeamRequest.Builder builder = RunTeamRequest.builder()
046                .stateVariables(values)
047                .userPrompt("Review the amount.");
048        RunTeamRequest first = builder.build();
049        RunTeamRequest next = builder.userPrompt("Explain the calculation.").build();
050        System.out.println("First prompt: " + first.getUserPrompt());
051        System.out.println("Next prompt: " + next.getUserPrompt());
052    }
053}
